sourceTitle: The Poetical Works of Oliver Wendell Holmes — Complete
description: "The Poetical Works of Oliver Wendell Holmes — Complete" by Oliver Wendell Holmes is a collection of poetry spanning a significant part of the 19th century. This compilation brings together Holmes's earlier works, additional poems, and various thematic segments, showcasing his skill in blending humor, reflection, and social commentary through verse.
